scenes.text: You probably use public restrooms all the time without thinking, but have you ever actually noticed that the toilet seats almost always have a strange, U-shaped gap right in the front?
This is not just some random design choice to save on plastic, but it is actually a strict legal requirement mandated by official plumbing codes all across the United States.
The open-front seat was created to solve a major hygiene issue by giving you crucial extra breathing room, ensuring your body and hands never have to touch the nasty, germ-filled surface.
It also prevents messy splashes from other users to keep the stall cleaner, so comment below if you already knew this secret bathroom design, and follow for more mind-blowing facts!
